name: Enchanting
title: Six-step modifier manipulation profession
summary: Enchanting has six cumulative steps: random modifier addition; full reforge; locking; extraction/insertion; raising one modifier's tier; and rerolling values of all unlocked modifiers while preserving identity/tier. Inserted modifiers need a free slot in their own group, and broken-item extraction is allowed.
scenarioNote: One extracted modifier is a single-use instance; extraction destroys its source item.

points.text: Learning the profession grants random addition; later skill thresholds unlock full reforge, locking, extraction/insertion, tier raising, and value change in sequence.
Full reforge regenerates all unlocked modifiers while preserving count and group distribution; locked modifiers stay unchanged.
Extraction destroys its source (even if broken) and creates one single-use instance; insertion into any base requires a free slot in that same modifier group and locks the inserted modifier.
Value change rerolls all unlocked numeric values within their existing tiers and preserves identities/groups/tiers; locked modifiers are unchanged.
No separate delete or replace operation exists.

gaps: Unlock thresholds after Step 1, operation costs/ingredients/time, random-add group choice, exact tables, and whether tier raising can target a locked modifier remain open.
